question: Bagaimana mengaktifkan notifikasi first blood Discord di rsctf? Cek dokumen dan implementasi repo ini. Sebut lokasi konfigurasi yang terbukti; apakah butuh relay eksternal?

findings.claim: Notifikasi first blood Discord di rsctf diaktifkan dengan mengatur webhook Discord game ke URL HTTPS resmi discord.com/api/webhooks/...

evidence.quote: Set the game's Discord webhook to an official HTTPS `discord.com/api/webhooks/...` URL to announce first, second, and third blood for Jeopardy challenges.

findings.claim: Pengaturan webhook Discord berada di konfigurasi game, bukan konfigurasi global platform.

evidence.quote: Set the game's Discord webhook to an official HTTPS `discord.com/api/webhooks/...` URL

findings.claim: Menonaktifkan blood bonus pada challenge hanya menghapus poin ekstra, tetapi badge blood dan pengumuman Discord tetap aktif.

evidence.quote: Turning off a challenge's blood bonus removes only the extra points; the blood badge and announcement remain active.

findings.claim: Pengumuman yang terjadi selama scoreboard freeze tetap diantrekan hingga game berakhir agar webhook tidak membocorkan solve yang dibekukan.

evidence.quote: Announcements reached during a scoreboard freeze stay queued until the game ends so the webhook cannot leak frozen solves.

findings.claim: Worker pengiriman mencoba ulang kegagalan Discord sementara dengan backoff terbatas, tetapi tidak memutar ulang blood yang terjadi sebelum webhook diaktifkan.

evidence.quote: The delivery worker retries temporary Discord failures with a bounded backoff, but does not replay bloods that occurred before webhook delivery was enabled.

findings.claim: Tidak diperlukan relay eksternal; rsctf mengirim langsung ke webhook Discord resmi.

evidence.quote: Set the game's Discord webhook to an official HTTPS `discord.com/api/webhooks/...` URL to announce first, second, and third blood for Jeopardy challenges.
